sections.content: Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping experience at the JBG Bergman Triathlon & Duathlon in Kolkata, organized by Deccan Sports Club. This exciting event is all set to take place on 9th February 2025. Whether you’re a seasoned triathlete or a passionate duathlon enthusiast, this event is designed to push your limits and celebrate your strength.
The Bergman 113 is a triathlon challenge where participants conquer 113 kilometers across three endurance disciplines:
Each segment is a test of physical and mental grit, making it an extraordinary journey for every participant.

The title Bergman is inspired by the German word for "mountain man." Historically, mountain dwellers had to scale challenging terrains daily, honing unmatched mental and physical toughness. This essence of strength and resilience aligns perfectly with the spirit of triathlon and duathlon events.
The routes designed by Deccan Sports Club take this idea further, leading participants through mountains, forests, and nature’s raw beauty, offering a mix of adventure and challenge.
Bergman Triathlon: A seamless blend of swimming, cycling, and running to test your endurance and determination.
Bergman Duathlon: A thrilling format with running, cycling, and another running leg for those who prefer land-based challenges.
These events aren’t just competitions; they’re experiences that celebrate courage, stamina, and the human spirit.
Explore the vibrant city while you take on this thrilling challenge!
Test your mental and physical limits.
Compete on unique, scenic routes crafted after years of research.
Join a community of like-minded endurance enthusiasts.
Earn the prestigious Bergman finisher title and bragging rights for conquering this mountainous task.
Take the plunge. Embrace the challenge. Become a Bergman.
